actors: owner or operator of a Voluntary Black Start unit

requirements.text: Do NOT perform any actions while following this plan that could endanger the safety of any person, damage equipment, harms the environment, or violates any applicable law, regulation, or operating limit.

requirements.section: Generator Unit Testing > Black Start Testing Minimal Requirements
requirements.text: Demonstrate at least every five years, through simulation or testing, that the unit can perform its intended functions as required by the WECC BCP (if any) and of this testing section.

requirements.section: Generator Unit Testing > Black Start Testing Minimal Requirements
requirements.text: Submit documentation of the test results and analysis to the CAISO, WECC, or NERC upon any request.

requirements.section: Generator Unit Testing > Black Start Testing Minimal Requirements
requirements.text: Submit any past reports for Black Start tests with the CAISO and WECC.

requirements.section: Generator Unit Testing > Black Start Testing Minimal Requirements
requirements.text: Those Participants who do not currently test their Black Start capability, will be required to test their Black Start capability.

requirements.section: Generator Unit Testing > Black Start Testing Minimal Requirements
requirements.text: Within 24 hours of conducting a Black Start test, all Participants will notify the CAISO RT Dispatcher by phone indicating the success or failure of the test.

requirements.section: Generator Unit Testing > Black Start Testing Minimal Requirements
requirements.text: Within 14 days of performing a Black Start test, all Participants will file a letter with the CAISO regarding the success or failure of the test.

requirements.section: Generator Unit Testing > Black Start Testing Minimal Requirements
requirements.text: Testing records shall include the dates of the tests, the duration of the tests, and an indication of whether the tests met the requirements of this Black Start Testing section.

requirements.section: Generator Unit Testing > Black Start Testing Minimal Requirements
requirements.text: The Black Start unit must have the ability to maintain voltage within emergency voltage limits over a range of loading from no external load to full external load in accordance with NERC reliability standards.

requirements.section: Generator Unit Testing > Black Start Testing Minimal Requirements
requirements.text: The Black Start unit must be equipped with governors that are capable of operating in an isochronous mode.

requirements.section: Generator Unit Testing > Black Start Testing Minimal Requirements
requirements.text: Adequate transmission capacity shall be available to connect the Black Start facility to the source providing station services to other specified generating stations.

requirements.section: Generator Unit Testing > Black Start Testing Minimal Requirements
requirements.text: The Black Start unit must be capable of starting and energizing the applicable transmission path without assistance from the electrical system.

requirements.section: Generator Unit Testing > Black Start Testing Minimal Requirements
requirements.text: The Black Start Test should include key operating aids used in Black Starts such as telephone communications and SCADA, if applicable.

requirements.section: Generator Unit Testing > Black Start Testing Minimal Requirements
requirements.text: Hydroelectric generating units or combustion gas turbines - within 30 minutes of the initiation of the Black Start process.

requirements.section: Generator Unit Testing > Black Start Testing Minimal Requirements
requirements.text: Industrial gas turbines - within 60 minutes of the initiation of the Black Start process.

requirements.section: Generator Unit Testing > Black Start Testing Minimal Requirements
requirements.text: Hot, steam-driven turbines, within 2.5 hours of the initiation of the Black Start process.

requirements.section: Generator Unit Testing > Black Start Testing Minimal Requirements
requirements.text: If the certified Black Start facility is in another reliability coordinator area or is comprised of an unspecified technology then specific start time limits are negotiated.

requirements.section: Generator Unit Testing > Black Start Testing Minimal Requirements
requirements.text: The minimum run time duration (the generation time after being synchronized to the grid) of a Black Start test is 10 minutes.

requirements.section: Generator Unit Testing > Black Start Testing Minimal Requirements
requirements.text: Submit a CAISO market schedule for any test energy.
